paraphrase: A physician skilled in application who has not understood the meaning of the science is to be known as Yama himself, death in the form of mortals. Mercury carries grave natural impurities, each causing its own affliction — swellings, skin disease, burning, loss of seed, death, eruptions and delusion; when mercury is free of impurities it removes death and old age; mercury with its impurities, though nectar itself, is poison. Therefore purification of mercury is enjoined for removing the impurities.
